question: Which of the following cricket players wrote the autobiography ‘Playing It My Way’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sachin Tendulkar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sachin Tendulkar** is the cricket player who wrote the autobiography 'Playing It My Way'.
 
• The autobiography was released in **2014** and covers his life and career in cricket.
 
• Sachin Tendulkar is widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
• He made his debut for the Indian cricket team at the age of 16 and has numerous records to his name, including being the first player to score 100 international centuries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sachin Tendulkar was born on **24th April 1973** in Mumbai, India.
 
• He received the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in 2014, becoming the first sportsperson to receive the award.
 
• In his career, he played **200 Test matches**, **463 One Day Internationals (ODIs)**, and a single Twenty20 International (T20I) for India.
 
• He retired from international cricket in **November 2013** after an illustrious career spanning 24 years.
 
• His autobiography 'Playing It My Way' provides an in-depth look into his personal and professional life, detailing his journey, challenges, and achievements in the world of cricket.
